description.text: The second XY set, released on 7 May 2014 with 109 cards: 106 and three secret Mega Pokémon-EX, the first secret rares of Mega Pokémon. It centers on Charizard, with two Mega Charizard-EX, one Fire and one Dragon, and other Fire Pokémon, and it has five new Pokémon-EX and three Mega Evolutions. Its cards came from the Japanese Wild Blaze set and the M Charizard-EX Mega Battle Deck.

description.text: The 1st Place League Challenge copy of Avalugg: a crosshatch holofoil print stamped with the Pokémon League logo and its placing, the prize for first place. League Challenges were small tournaments that a store running a Pokémon League could hold once a month; each came with a sealed kit of twelve of these cards, three for each place, for the top four players in each age division. The crosshatch pattern marks the early League Challenge promos, from the first events in 2013 until BREAKthrough in 2015.
